groups.label: Client Presentation Layer
groups.description: The user-facing Next.js application responsible for UI rendering and initiating generation requests.

groups.label: Generation Backend Core (FastAPI)
groups.description: The central Python service orchestrating data fetching, AI calls, state management, and validation.

groups.label: External Services & Data Sources
groups.description: Third-party APIs and cloud services used for persistence, intelligence, and raw data input.

nodes.label: Next.js Frontend UI
nodes.description: Renders the interactive user interface, including diagram visualization and repository browsing components.

nodes.label: Client API Routes (Next.js)
nodes.description: Handles embedded generation calls and data fetching within the Vercel deployment boundary.

nodes.label: FastAPI Orchestrator
nodes.description: The main entry point for the robust, production-grade generation pipeline.

nodes.label: GitHub Data Fetching
nodes.description: Responsible for fetching raw repository metadata, file trees, and README content from GitHub API.

nodes.label: Prompt Generation Logic
nodes.description: Structures and prepares contextually rich instructions for the external AI model.

nodes.label: AI Service Orchestration
nodes.description: Coordinates calls to external LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI) and manages model configuration.

nodes.label: Graph Structure Logic
nodes.description: Takes raw data and AI output to structure the final architectural graph representation.

nodes.label: State & Quota Management
nodes.description: Checks usage quotas and tracks transient state using Redis.

nodes.label: Mermaid Validation Utility
nodes.description: Ensures the generated Mermaid code is syntactically correct before final output.

nodes.label: GitHub API
nodes.description: Source of raw repository metadata and file structure.

nodes.label: AI Model Provider (OpenAI)
nodes.description: The external Large Language Model used for complex data interpretation and generation.

nodes.label: Upstash Redis Store
nodes.description: High-speed storage for transient state, usage quotas, and session data.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 Artifact Store
nodes.description: The final, persistent storage for successful diagram artifacts and derived data.

edges.label: Generation Call
edges.description: Triggers the backend orchestration flow (Production Mode).

edges.label: Check Quota/State
edges.description: Verifies user permissions and usage limits.

edges.label: Read/Write State
edges.description: Reads or updates the current generation state and quota count.

edges.label: API Call
edges.description: Retrieves file tree, branches, and README content.

edges.label: Contextual Prompting
edges.description: Prepares the instructions for the AI model based on fetched data.

edges.label: Instructions & Context
edges.description: Sends structured prompts to the AI service.

edges.label: LLM API Call
edges.description: Requests complex data interpretation and graph generation logic.

edges.label: Raw Output Data
edges.description: Receives the initial structured output (e.g., JSON/Mermaid code).

edges.label: Code Validation
edges.description: Submits the generated Mermaid syntax for validation.

edges.label: Validated Code
edges.description: Returns confirmed, clean Mermaid code to the orchestrator.

edges.label: Save Artifact
edges.description: Commits the final diagram and metadata to permanent storage.

rawText:
{
  "groups": [
    {
      "id": "client_presentation",
      "label": "Client Presentation Layer",
      "description": "The user-facing Next.js application responsible for UI rendering and initiating generation requests."
    },
    {
      "id": "backend_core",
      "label": "Generation Backend Core (FastAPI)",
      "description": "The central Python service orchestrating data fetching, AI calls, state management, and validation."
    },
    {
      "id": "external_services",
      "label": "External Services & Data Sources",
      "description": "Third-party APIs and cloud services used for persistence, intelligence, and raw data input."
    }
  ],
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "nextjs_frontend",
      "label": "Next.js Frontend UI",
      "type": "Client Application",
      "description": "Renders the interactive user interface, including diagram visualization and repository browsing components.",
      "groupId": "client_presentation",
      "path": "src/app",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "api_routes_client",
      "label": "Client API Routes (Next.js)",
      "type": "API Endpoint",
      "description": "Handles embedded generation calls and data fetching within the Vercel deployment boundary.",
      "groupId": "client_presentation",
      "path": "src/app/api",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "fastapi_backend",
      "label": "FastAPI Orchestrator",
      "type": "Backend Service",
      "description": "The main entry point for the robust, production-grade generation pipeline.",
      "groupId": "backend_core",
      "path": "backend/app/main.py",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "github_fetcher",
      "label": "GitHub Data Fetching",
      "type": "Data Ingestion Module",
      "description": "Responsible for fetching raw repository metadata, file trees, and README content from GitHub API.",
      "groupId": "backend_core",
      "path": "backend/app/services/github_service.py",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "prompt_manager",
      "label": "Prompt Generation Logic",
      "type": "Utility Service",
      "description": "Structures and prepares contextually rich instructions for the external AI model.",
      "groupId": "backend_core",
      "path": "backend/app/prompts.py",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "ai_orchestrator",
      "label": "AI Service Orchestration",
      "type": "API Client",
      "description": "Coordinates calls to external LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI) and manages model configuration.",
      "groupId": "backend_core",
      "path": "backend/app/services/openai_service.py",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "graph_generator",
      "label": "Graph Structure Logic",
      "type": "Core Business Logic",
      "description": "Takes raw data and AI output to structure the final architectural graph representation.",
      "groupId": "backend_core",
      "path": "backend/app/services/graph_service.py",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "state_manager",
      "label": "State & Quota Management",
      "type": "Utility Service",
      "description": "Checks usage quotas and tracks transient state using Redis.",
      "groupId": "backend_core",
      "path": "backend/app/services/complimentary_gate.py",
      "shape": "box"
    },
    {
      "id": "mermaid_validator",
      "label": "Mermaid Validation Utility",
      "type": "Validation Tool",
      "description": "Ensures the generated Mermaid code is syntactically correct before final output.",
      "groupId": "backend_core",
      "path": "backend/scripts/validate_mermaid.mjs",
      "shape": "hexagon"
    },
    {
      "id": "github_api",
      "label": "GitHub API",
      "type": "External Data Source",
      "description": "Source of raw repository metadata and file structure.",
      "groupId": "external_services",
      "path": null,
      "shape": "database"
    },
    {
      "id": "ai_model_provider",
      "label": "AI Model Provider (OpenAI)",
      "type": "External AI Service",
      "description": "The external Large Language Model used for complex data interpretation and generation.",
      "groupId": "external_services",
      "path": null,
      "shape": "circle"
    },
    {
      "id": "redis_store",
      "label": "Upstash Redis Store",
      "type": "Cache/State Database",
      "description": "High-speed storage for transient state, usage quotas, and session data.",
      "groupId": "external_services",
      "path": null,
      "shape": "queue"
    },
    {
      "id": "r2_storage",
      "label": "Cloudflare R2 Artifact Store",
      "type": "Object Storage",
      "description": "The final, persistent storage for successful diagram artifacts and derived data.",
      "groupId": "external_services",
      "path": null,
      "shape": "document"
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "from": "nextjs_frontend",
      "to": "api_routes_client",
      "label": "User Request",
      "description": "Initiates the diagram generation process.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "api_routes_client",
      "to": "fastapi_backend",
      "label": "Generation Call",
      "description": "Triggers the backend orchestration flow (Production Mode).",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "fastapi_backend",
      "to": "state_manager",
      "label": "Check Quota/State",
      "description": "Verifies user permissions and usage limits.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "state_manager",
      "to": "redis_store",
      "label": "Read/Write State",
      "description": "Reads or updates the current generation state and quota count.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "fastapi_backend",
      "to": "github_fetcher",
      "label": "Fetch Raw Data",
      "description": "Requests repository metadata from GitHub.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "github_fetcher",
      "to": "github_api",
      "label": "API Call",
      "description": "Retrieves file tree, branches, and README content.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "fastapi_backend",
      "to": "prompt_manager",
      "label": "Contextual Prompting",
      "description": "Prepares the instructions for the AI model based on fetched data.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "prompt_manager",
      "to": "ai_orchestrator",
      "label": "Instructions & Context",
      "description": "Sends structured prompts to the AI service.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "ai_orchestrator",
      "to": "ai_model_provider",
      "label": "LLM API Call",
      "description": "Requests complex data interpretation and graph generation logic.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "ai_model_provider",
      "to": "graph_generator",
      "label": "Raw Output Data",
      "description": "Receives the initial structured output (e.g., JSON/Mermaid code).",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "graph_generator",
      "to": "mermaid_validator",
      "label": "Code Validation",
      "description": "Submits the generated Mermaid syntax for validation.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "mermaid_validator",
      "to": "fastapi_backend",
      "label": "Validated Code",
      "description": "Returns confirmed, clean Mermaid code to the orchestrator.",
      "style": "solid"
    },
    {
      "from": "fastapi_backend",
      "to": "r2_storage",
      "label": "Save Artifact",
      "description": "Commits the final diagram and metadata to permanent storage.",
      "style": "solid"
    }
  ]
}
